work.title: The Monkey's Paw
work.parent_series: The Simpsons, Treehouse of Horror II (season 3)

summary: The segment is mainly based on W. W. Jacobs's story, but its alien-invasion subplot borrows from the 1985 revival episode "A Small Talent for War."
A sketch that drops a tongue-twister routine into a Twilight Zone-style setup, reviewed by Slashfilm as one of the episode's highlights.
